_test_case_note: v0.0.2 ASN.1 EMSC -- one self-contained job+pipeline decoding the real EMSC.asn1 module (BT_Usecase/UC7/data/asn_schema/EMSC.asn1) into flowx.bronze_emsc.emsc_cdr_raw. ROOT PDU AUTO-DETECTION IS THE HEADLINE: asn1_pdu_name is deliberately OMITTED from source_config, so asn1/decoder.py::detect_root_pdu_name resolves the root PDU out of the module itself -- EMSC.asn1 -> CallDataRecord, verified by calling detect_root_pdu_name() directly against this schema. asn1_pdu_name became OPTIONAL in 0.0.2 (spec_validator.py no longer requires it and ingestion/readers.py no longer subscripts it); an explicitly supplied value still wins as an override, but this spec exercises the detection path. CHOICE ROOT: CallDataRecord is a CHOICE with 2 arms, so the decoded frame carries one nullable column per arm (uMTSGSMPLMNCallDataRecord, compositeCallDataRecord) PLUS the synthetic '_choice' discriminator naming the arm actually selected -- without which a consumer cannot tell 'arm absent' from 'arm present but NULL'. All 10 fixtures select uMTSGSMPLMNCallDataRecord, so compositeCallDataRecord is NULL on every row. ON THE FIXTURES: BT_Usecase/UC7/data/synthetic/emsc_synthetic.ber is NOT used, because it holds 10 records concatenated as back-to-back TLVs in ONE file, and the framework decoder calls compiled.decode() once on a whole file's bytes -- asn1tools then returns only the FIRST TLV silently, ingesting 1 row and dropping 9 while reporting success. notebooks/00_seed_sample_data/05_seed_asn1_emsc_fixture.py therefore writes each record as its own .ber file (10 files -> 10 rows) and self-checks that invariant at seed time. BT_Usecase/UC7/data/tap311_sample.ber is likewise unused (malformed 16-byte payload matching no CHOICE arm). ON THE DQ RULES BEING DELIBERATELY THIN: UMTSGSMPLMNCallDataRecord is a SEQUENCE whose two members -- callDataRecord and eventModule -- are BOTH OPTIONAL. Measured over these exact 10 deterministic records (random.Random(20260903 + i)): eventModule present in 7/10, callDataRecord present in 4/10, leaf values per record 8-53. NEITHER member is present in all 10, so asserting either one non-null would false-quarantine real, valid records. The rules below therefore assert only what actually holds on all 10: decode succeeded, a CHOICE arm was selected, the arm is the expected one, and the selected arm carries at least one of its two optional members. record_id_column is '_choice', a genuine top-level column -- dq/quarantine.py requires the column to be in df.columns and silently ignores a dotted struct path.
_expected_result: bronze_emsc.emsc_cdr_raw holds exactly 10 rows. Every row: _asn1_decode_error IS NULL, _choice = 'uMTSGSMPLMNCallDataRecord', uMTSGSMPLMNCallDataRecord IS NOT NULL, and compositeCallDataRecord NULL. The uMTSGSMPLMNCallDataRecord struct exposes the full member set derived from EMSC.asn1 with no schema mismatch or truncation; its two members are OPTIONAL and legitimately sparse (eventModule on 7 of the 10 rows, callDataRecord on 4, one row carrying both), which is correct behaviour and not a defect. Quarantine table emsc_cdr_raw_quarantine stays EMPTY.

ingestion_flows.source_description: v0.0.2: BER-encoded EMSC mobile-switching-centre call data records decoded against the real EMSC.asn1 module. Root PDU is auto-detected (asn1_pdu_name omitted) as CallDataRecord, a 2-arm CHOICE -- decoding projects one column per arm plus the '_choice' discriminator. Fixtures are landed one record per .ber file by notebooks/00_seed_sample_data/05_seed_asn1_emsc_fixture.py.

rules.expression: _choice <> 'uMTSGSMPLMNCallDataRecord' OR uMTSGSMPLMNCallDataRecord.callDataRecord IS NOT NULL OR uMTSGSMPLMNCallDataRecord.eventModule IS NOT NULL
